'''''Republic Commando: Order 66''''', also stylized as '''''Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel''''', is the fourth novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]], released in [[September]] [[2008]]. It was the first ''Republic Commando'' novel to be released in hardcover for general release. However, for its UK release, it was only released as a paperback. The paperback version was released [[May 19]], [[2009]].
